filter_recurrence_semantics: Check the sealed KWR75 filtered channel against the provider's declared one-pole tau and each row's actual dt; it is a consistency check, not a force-truth validation.
interpretation_limit: Fused replay reproduces the sealed formal outer-loop twist before the filtered-only comparison. The counterfactual changes only the KWR75 normal value supplied to the outer loop. It does not feed candidate commands into robot observations or predict force MAE. The same mature RNN, host slew and shared final task-space qdot gate are replayed; pre-gate cap hits and post-gate slew are both measured, and KWR75-force-triggered RNN warm-start/direction retry are recomputed. The force-rise entry guard is not part of this PATH-only command replay. No live suitability follows.
